# eon_restore_account_region_aws_security_groups (Data Source)

Retrieves security groups available in an AWS restore-account region. Use this data source to select `security_group_ids` for `eon_restore_job`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eon_restore_account_region_aws_security_groups" "destination" {
  restore_account_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  region             = "us-east-1"
  vpc_id             = "vpc-0123456789abcdef0"
  subnet_id          = "subnet-0123456789abcdef0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) AWS Region where the security groups are located.
- `restore_account_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the AWS restore account.

### Optional

- `subnet_id` (String) Optional cloud-provider-assigned subnet ID to filter the security groups.
- `vpc_id` (String) Optional cloud-provider-assigned VPC ID to filter the security groups.

### Read-Only

- `security_groups` (Attributes List) List of security groups available in the restore account region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--security_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--security_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `security_groups`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Cloud-provider-assigned ID of the security group.
- `name` (String) Name of the security group.
- `vpc` (String) Cloud-provider-assigned ID of the VPC containing the security group.
